title: Diarrhoea and vomiting — when to seek help
content: Call 999 or go to A&E if you vomit blood or vomit that looks like ground coffee, have green vomit, may have swallowed something poisonous, have a stiff neck and pain when looking at bright lights, have a sudden severe headache or a sudden severe tummy ache, have blue, grey, pale or blotchy skin, lips or tongue, are having severe difficulty breathing or taking lots of quick short breaths, or are confused or not responding as usual. Contact NHS 111 if you still have signs of dehydration after using oral rehydration, you keep being sick and cannot keep fluid down, you have bloody diarrhoea or bleeding from the bottom, or you have had diarrhoea for more than 7 days or vomiting for more than 2 days.
